content: Yuhuda Kawo Amasiyaasa
Isra7eele kawo Iyo7akaaze naa Yo7aasi kawotida nam7anththo layththan Yuhuda kawo Iyo7aasa naa Amasiyaasi kawotides.
Izi kawotiza wode izas layththay 25; izi Yerusalaamen uttidi 29 layth haarides; iza aaya Yoha7adaano geetettiza Yerusalaame maccassa.
Amasiyaasi GODAA sinththan lo7o miish ooththides; gido attiin kase iza aawa Dawiti ooththoyssa mala ooththibeenna; ubbaa miishshika ba aawa Iyo7aasi ooththoyssaththo ooththides.
Zumbullata bolla diza goynnizasoti kichchibeettenna; asay zumbullata bolla yarsho shiishonne Exaane cuwaseth essibeenna.
Amasiyaasi ba kawoteththaa minththi oykkidaappe guye ba aawaa wodhida shuumeta wodhides.

Gido attiin Muse woga maxaafan GODAY, «Asi ba ooththida nagaran hayqqo attiin aawati bantta nayta nagaran, nayti bantta aawata nagaran hayqqofetto» giidi azazida gishshas kase shemppo wodhidayta nayta wodhibeenna.
Amasiyaasi, «Maxine shoobba» geetettizason Eedoome asaappe 10,000 wurssides; Seela oli oykkidi hach gakkanaas Yoqiti7eele geetettiza sunth immides.
Hessafe guye Amasiyaasi Iyus naaza naa Iyo7akaaze naa Isra7eele kawo Iyo7aasakko, «Haa ya; ane olaza tiran gayttoos» giidi qasttanne yeddides.

Isra7eele kawo Yo7aasi Yuhuda kawo Amasiyaases, «Issi Libaanoose kindichchoy issi Libaanoose ziga, ‹Ne nayo ta naazas machcho imma› gides. Hessafe guye issi Libaanooseppe wora do7ay yiidi kindichchoza ba tohon yedhdhides.
Tumakka ne Eedoome xoonadasa; gidikkoka ne wozinay wogay baynda otorettofo; ne iza xoonida gishshas zaradhettofa; shempa utta! Neni ne kundeththinne Yuhuda kundeth ays koyay?» gi kiittides.
Gido attiin Amasiyaasi izi gizayssa siyontta ixxides; hessa gishshas Isra7eele kawo Yo7aasi olas kezides; izinne Yuhuda kawo Amasiyaasikka Yuhuda deren Beeti-Shemisheppe sinththa baggan ola danxxida.
Yuhuday Isra7eelen xoonettides; asay issoy issoy baso baso baqatides.

Isra7eele kawoy Yo7aasi Akaziyaasas naaza naa Iyo7aasa naaza Yuhuda kawo Amasiyaasa Beeti-Shemishen di7ides. Hessafe guye Yo7aasi Yerusalaame bides; Efreeme gimbe pengefe doommidi gula penge geetettizaso gakkanaas adussateththay 400 wadha gidida gimbeza laallides.
GODAA Keeththaninne kawo minjja keeththan diza worqqa, biranne heen beettida miish ubbaa ekkidi di7ettida asaakka oykki ekkidi Samaariya simmides.
Yo7aasa kawoteththa layththatan oosettidaazi, polettidaazinne hanida hanoti ubbay Yuhuda kawo Amasiyaasara olettida olay ubbay Isra7eele kawota taarike maxaafan xaafetti dees gidennee?
Yo7aasi hayqqidi ba aawatan gayttides; kase Isra7eele kawoti moogettiza Samaariyan kawota duufon moogettides; iza naa Iyorba7aamey izasohon kawotides.
Yo7aasa naazi Yuhuda kawo Amasiyaasikka Isra7eele kawo Iyo7akaaze naa Iyo7aasi hayqqidaappe guye 15 layth de7ides.
Amasiyaasa kawoteththa layththatan hanida hanoti Yuhuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetti dees gidennee?
Yerusalaame asay Amasiyaasa bolla seeri dendida gishshas izi gede Laakishe baqati bides; gido attiin istti ba baggara iza kaalettiza as kiittidi wodhisida.
Iza ahazikka paran caanetti yiidi Dawite katamaan kase iza aawati moogettizason Yerusalaamen moogettides.
Hessafe guye Yuhuda dere ubbay 16 layththa naa Azaariyaasa ekkidi iza aawa Amasiyaasa sohon kawoththida.
Amasiyaasi hayqqidi ba aawatan gayttidaappe guye Azaariyaasi Eelaate zaari ooththidi Yuhudan gaaggides.
Isra7eelen Kawotida Nam7anththo Iyorba7aame
Iyosiyaasa naa Amasiyaasi Yuhudan kawotida tammanne ichchashanththo layththan Isra7eele kawo Yo7aasa naa Iyorba7aamey Samaariyan kawotides; 41 layth gakkanaas haarides.
Izi GODAA sinththan iita miish ooththides; Nabaaxe naa Iyorba7aamey kase Isra7eele asaa oosisida nagaraappe guye simmibeenna.
GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay Geet-Hefeere nabe Amaate naa ba aylle Yoonaasa baggara yootida mala Hamaate aadhdhiza purdefe biidi hayqo abbaa gakkanaas diza Isra7eele zawaa zaarissiday Iyorba7aame.
Aylle gidiin woykko goqa gidiin Isra7eelen dizay ubbayka keehi waayettizayssa GODAY be7ides; istta maaddizaykka deenna.
Gido attiin GODAY Isra7eele sunththaa biitta bollafe dhayssana giidi kase yootibeenna gishshas Yo7aasa naa Iyorba7aamen eqqidi istta ashshides.

Iyorba7aame kawoteththa layththatan izi ooththidaazi, hanida hanotinne olettida olati hessaththoka kase Yuhuday haarizasota Damasqonne Hamaate izi Isra7eeles wostti zaaridaakko Isra7eele kawota taarike maxaafan xaafetti dees gidennee?
Iyorba7aamey hayqqidi ba aawatan gayttides; iza naa Zakaraasi izasohon kawotides.
